title: The Knight Who Chose Peace
moral: True courage lies in seeking peace before conflict.

scenes.summary: Elara values order and dreams of peace instead of war.
scenes.text: Dame Elara, a disciplined knight who values order, prepares for battle but dreams of a world where weapons remain unused.

scenes.summary: A war threat emerges from the north.

scenes.summary: Elara proves that peace is stronger than war.

story: Dame Elara is a disciplined knight who values order and dreams of peace. When war threatens her kingdom, she chooses a different path and offers to speak with the enemy instead of fighting. Along with her squire Elian, she journeys north, risking her life to uncover the truth behind the conflict. Through courage, wisdom, and calm reasoning, she seeks to prevent war. Elara proves that true bravery is not just fighting but choosing peace when possible.
